scope: Gameplay-only planning estimate; not overall beta completion or a test pass rate

rubric.rationale: Prototype champion guard counterplay and a half-health movement phase; arena arrival resets old aim pitch. Existing authoritative firing/reload/wipe/restart checks pass. No human combat-feel, production animation or performance credit.
Retain previous credit. Existing personal primary/secondary loadouts survive new route transitions. No new finished weapon, ten-secondary catalog or art/balance acceptance.

Finite three/four-unique-arena routes, majority votes with seeded ties, deadlines, relay objectives, finale and idempotent clearance/XP. Twenty thousand model routes and integrated real-world checks pass. Only four prototypes, not ten finished arenas; intended 45–60-minute pacing, survival mode and saved checkpoints remain open.

Four real local Editor peers share route choices and bounded victory. A route voter disconnect leaves three eligible players, who finish. Four-peer real sixty-second recovery and two-peer combat/wipe/restart pass. No Steam/Internet, human full-run or AI takeover/reclaim acceptance.

Retain previous credit for grounded ten-perk effects/profiles and staged setup. New arena-clear XP is idempotent. Character preselection, shared reveal, authenticated reconnect and human balance remain open.

assessment_note: 7.5 planning points above VS29: combat +1.5, run framework/prototypes +5, co-op route handling +1. No finished production content, human-fun, Internet or minimum-PC credit inferred from accelerated fixtures.
